review_runs.summary: Clear, well-exemplified teaching of identification, description, and existential overlap. All endorsed Norwegian forms are standard Bokmål. Main defects: two valid completions rejected without sufficient restrictions, misleading location feedback, and an unclear referent in a connected model. All selected sources reviewed; unlisted items have no grounded defect. Inspected all 13 exercises. Each serves obj-det-er-vs-det-finnes-01 through meaning recognition, controlled completion, error repair, or message writing involving identification/description versus existence/availability. Focused practice with known-item descriptions, locations, and existence questions supports objective; no genuine alignment mismatches found.
